'''Refuse Row''' was the name given to the entrance street of [[Shadow Town]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex operated by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Unlike the rest of the sector, Refuse Row was not monitored or patrolled by the Empire, allowing the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to set up a [[Strategic Information Service base (Nar Shaddaa)|base]] there.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Refuse Row appears as part of Shadow Town on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
